audience: product and research teams who collect survey responses with Formbricks

useCases.title: Summarize the answers to a survey
useCases.text: The AI lists responses for one survey, one contact or a date window and opens single ones. It sums up what people answered.

useCases.title: Check which webhooks are set up
useCases.text: The AI lists webhooks, optionally for specific surveys, and reads each one's URL, triggers and bound surveys.

useCases.title: Create or remove a webhook
useCases.text: The AI registers a webhook that fires on survey events, or removes one you no longer need. It checks the current list first.

useCases.title: Get personal survey links to send
useCases.text: The AI gets a personalised survey URL for one contact, or for every contact in a segment, so each response is tied to a person.

useCases.title: Check contact attributes or add a contact
useCases.text: The AI lists the contact attribute keys of an environment, then creates a contact from attributes such as email and userId.

useCases.title: Delete a response for a data-deletion request
useCases.text: The AI finds the survey response of a person and deletes it. This cannot be undone.
